scope: Website-only Blanc Mail address reservation copy shown while site/src/data/mail-reservations.json says open: the homepage band, and the banner above the site header on every page but the Mail, legal and What's New pages (the homepage included). Not a claim about a desktop release.
qualification: Reserving is free and holds the name on every ending listed in mail-reservations.json (inbox.day, blnc.day and blancmail.me since November 19, 2026) until Blanc Mail addresses open, as the reserve page says; claiming one later needs a paid plan, which the reserve page states beside its button. On November 23, 2026 the owner had the banner's “Reserve yours on @inbox.day, free.”, which could read as a free address, reworded to “Reserve yours for free @inbox.day.”, so “free” describes reserving; phones drop “for free” and show “Reserve yours @inbox.day.” The band and the banner render only while reservations are open; the banner names the first ending in mail-reservations.json.
